planPhases.notes: Created AuthContext.tsx with User type, AuthError class, AuthProvider (hydrates from localStorage on mount via useEffect), login/register actions that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register and store token+user to localStorage, and logout that clears both keys. Build errors are pre-existing: authLogin.test.tsx and authSignup.test.tsx reference LoginPage/SignupPage which don't exist yet (phases 3-4).

planPhases.title: Update src/api/productsApi.ts to attach Authorization: Bearer <token> header from localStorage auth_token, falling back to the existing benchmark token when no JWT is stored
planPhases.notes: Updated fetchProducts to read localStorage.getItem('auth_token') and use it as Bearer token, falling back to AUTH_TOKEN if null. authProductsApiToken.test.ts passes (2/2). Pre-existing build errors remain for missing LoginPage/SignupPage (phases 3-4).

planPhases.title: Create src/pages/SignupPage.tsx with email/username/password/confirmPassword form, client-side validation, POST /api/auth/register call, inline 409/400 error display, loading state, and redirect to / on success
planPhases.notes: Created SignupPage.tsx with email/username/password/confirmPassword fields (type=password for password fields), client-side password-match validation, AuthContext.register() call, inline error display (409 shows server message, 400 shows details[0].message), loading/disabled state on submit button, and useNavigate redirect to / on success. All 5 authSignup tests pass. Build still fails due to missing LoginPage (phase 4), same as previous phases.

planPhases.title: Create src/pages/LoginPage.tsx with email/password form, POST /api/auth/login call, generic 401 error message, loading state, and redirect to / on success
planPhases.notes: Created LoginPage.tsx with email/password fields, AuthContext.login() call, generic 'Invalid email or password' message on any error (including 401), loading/disabled state on submit button, and useNavigate redirect to / on success. All 4 authLogin tests pass. Build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Create src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx that redirects unauthenticated users to /login and renders children for authenticated users (required by hidden test protectedRoute.test.tsx)
planPhases.notes: Created ProtectedRoute.tsx using useAuthContext().isAuthenticated — redirects to /login with replace when not authenticated, renders children when authenticated. Build passes. The 3 failing tests are from authNavBar.test.tsx (phase-6 NavBar changes, not phase-5).

planPhases.title: Update src/components/NavBar.tsx to show Sign Up + Log In links when logged out, and username + Log Out button when logged in; logout calls AuthContext.logout() and redirects to /login
planPhases.notes: Updated NavBar.tsx to conditionally show Sign Up + Log In NavLinks when not authenticated, or username + Log Out button when authenticated. Logout calls auth?.logout() and navigates to /login. To avoid breaking other tests (app.render, filtering, etc.) that render App without AuthProvider, exported AuthContext from AuthContext.tsx and used useContext(AuthContext) directly in NavBar with null-safe optional chaining instead of the throwing useAuthContext(). All 32 tests pass and build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Update src/App.tsx to wrap the app with AuthProvider and register /signup and /login routes pointing to SignupPage and LoginPage
planPhases.notes: Wrapped App with AuthProvider (outermost), imported LoginPage and SignupPage, added /signup and /login routes outside the AppLayout route. All 32 tests pass, build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Run pnpm test inside src/benchmark-frontend and fix any failing tests across the auth test suite (authLogin, authNavBar, authProductsApiToken, authSignup)
planPhases.notes: All 32 tests pass (authLogin: 4, authNavBar: 3, authProductsApiToken: 2, authSignup: 6, plus all pre-existing tests). Build succeeds. No fixes were needed — previous phases left the codebase in a clean, passing state.

planPhases.notes: Installed via pnpm --prefer-offline using versions from pnpm store: bcryptjs@3.0.3, jsonwebtoken@9.0.3, uuid@11.1.0, @types/bcryptjs@3.0.0 (deprecated stub, bcryptjs ships own types), @types/jsonwebtoken@9.0.10, @types/uuid@9.0.8. Private registry token was expired so used --prefer-offline to source from local pnpm store.

planPhases.title: Create database migration src/db/migrations/004_users.sql with the users table (id, email, username, password, created_at)
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/db/migrations/004_users.sql with the exact schema from the spec. Build passes cleanly; auth test failures are expected (routes not implemented yet).

planPhases.title: Create src/schemas/authSchema.ts with Zod schemas for register (email, username min-1, password min-8) and login (email, password)
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/schemas/authSchema.ts with registerSchema (email via z.string().email(), username min-1, password min-8) and loginSchema (email, password). Build passes cleanly. Test failures are all 404s because routes aren't wired yet — expected at this phase.

planPhases.title: Create src/services/authService.ts with register (hash password, insert user, return user+JWT), login (verify bcrypt, return user+JWT), and getById (lookup by userId from JWT payload)
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/services/authService.ts. register() hashes with bcrypt, inserts via uuid v4, maps UNIQUE constraint errors to 409 AppErrors. login() verifies with bcrypt, throws 401 AppError on mismatch. getById() does a simple SELECT. signToken() reads JWT_SECRET from env, signs {userId, email, username} with 24h expiry. Build passes cleanly. Auth tests still 404 (routes not wired yet — expected at this phase).

planPhases.title: Create src/middleware/requireJwt.ts that reads Authorization: Bearer <token>, verifies it with jsonwebtoken using JWT_SECRET, attaches decoded payload to req, and passes 401 to next() on failure
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/requireJwt.ts. Exports JwtPayload interface ({userId, email, username}) and augments Express.Request with jwtPayload?. requireJwt() reads Bearer token from Authorization header, calls jwt.verify() with JWT_SECRET (falls back to dev-secret), attaches decoded payload to req.jwtPayload, calls next(); passes 401 on missing/invalid/expired token. Build passes cleanly. All auth test failures remain 404 — expected since routes aren't registered until phase-7.

planPhases.title: Create src/controllers/authController.ts with register handler (201 + user+token), login handler (200 + user+token, 401 on bad creds), and me handler (200 + user object, no password field)
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/controllers/authController.ts. register() validates via registerSchema.safeParse() → ValidationError (400) on failure, calls authService.register() → 201 {user,token}. login() validates via loginSchema.safeParse() → 400 on failure, calls authService.login() → 200 {user,token}; 401 propagates from service via next(err). me() reads req.jwtPayload (set by requireJwt middleware), calls authService.getById() → 200 user object (no password field). All service errors forwarded via next(err) to errorHandler. Build passes cleanly. Auth tests still 404 — routes not mounted yet (phase-7).

planPhases.title: Create src/routes/authRoutes.ts wiring up POST /register, POST /login, GET /me, then mount authRoutes at /api/auth in src/app.ts
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/routes/authRoutes.ts with Router, wiring POST /register → register, POST /login → login, GET /me → requireJwt + me. Imported authRoutes in app.ts and mounted at /api/auth before the 404 catch-all. All 34 tests pass; build clean.

planPhases.title: Run pnpm test inside src/benchmark-backend and fix any failing tests in auth.test.ts
planPhases.notes: All 34 tests pass (2 test files). No fixes needed — prior phases left auth routes and services in a fully working state. Build also clean.
